rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone takes responsibility for a project, task, or undertaking.

example.english: We undertake the organization of this community event.
example.traditional: 我哋負責籌辦今次社區活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fu6 zaak3 cau4 baan6 gam1 ci3 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the start or launch of an activity, rather than for assuming responsibility for it.

example.english: We undertake preparations for next month’s exhibition.
example.traditional: 我哋開始籌備下個月嘅展覽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 cau4 bei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 zin2 laam5

rows.note: Use this when someone commits or promises to do something.

example.english: I undertake to help him move house.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daap3 jing3 zo2 bong1 keoi5 bun1 uk1
